reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is to mathematically formalize the dyadic interaction between an attacker and defender while accounting for higher-order team effects. We treat the basketball court as a two-dimensional potential landscape where each player exerts a force. The attacker's drive is modeled as a gradient descent on the combined potential field created by all players. The resulting system of coupled ordinary differential equations (ODEs) describes the evolution of positions and velocities.
